meta.name: invoice
meta.description: 标准发票: 寄件/收件 + 明细 + 税 + 总额 + 付款指引

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成标准发票，包含明细、税额和付款指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成符合税务规范的发票
copy.tagline_en: Generate standard invoices with line items, tax, and payment instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate tax-compliant invoices

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能生成 A4 可打印的发票页面，包含发票号、日期、寄件/收件信息、明细表格、税项和总金额、付款指引，并自动添加打印样式。
howto.when: 当用户要求开具发票、打印账单，或需要标准发票格式时触发。

say.text: 帮我开一张发票，寄件方是ABC公司，收件方是我的客户。
say.note: Claude 会填充寄件/收件信息并生成发票。

say.text: 生成一笔包含三个明细项目、税率9%的总金额发票。
say.note: Claude 会列出明细并计算税额和总额。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can generate an A4 printable invoice page with invoice number, date, from/to info, line items, tax breakdown, totals, and payment instructions, with print styles.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create an invoice, print a bill, or needs a standard invoice format.

say_en.text: Create an invoice from ABC Company to my client.
say_en.note: Claude fills in the from/to info.

say_en.text: Generate an invoice with three line items and 9% tax.
say_en.note: Claude lists items and calculates totals.
